target_profile.description: At INNOVERA.AI, we have built an AI-native Decision Intelligence Platform where specialized AI agents create a live digital twin of any business initiative. Built on 40 years of Stanford research and protected by 3 patents, our platform combines stochastic modeling under uncertainty with domain experts and Forward Deployed Advisors in the loop — running simultaneous scenario paths, assigning probability weightings, and surfacing the optimal decision in a matter of days. Think of it as having a Top Tier Consultancy team in your pocket, working at the speed of AI — helping enterprises go from uncertainty to action across market entry, new venture validation, investment diligence, and technology selection.
target_profile.audience: Corporate innovators, strategy teams, and executives

framing_seeds.direct: Other AI-native decision intelligence, strategy, market research, competitive analysis, or initiative digital-twin platforms.
framing_seeds.problem_sharer: Consulting firms and expert networks solving strategic decisions under uncertainty, including blended AI plus human models such as McKinsey QuantumBlack, BCG X, Bain Vector, Accenture, GLG, and Third Bridge.

framing_seeds.adjacency: Big 4 firms, foundation-model labs, CRMs/ERPs, Palantir-like decision layers, sovereign funds, and trading houses with data, capital, or distribution that could enter decision intelligence.
